data.desc: The Marzetti Company manufactures and sells specialty food products. Our retail brands include Marzetti®, New York Bakery and Sister Schubert's®, in addition to exclusive license agreements for Olive Garden® dressings, Chick-fil-A® sauces and dressings, Buffalo Wild Wings® sauces, Arby's® sauces, Subway® sauces, and Texas Roadhouse® steak sauces and frozen rolls. Our foodservice business supplies many of the top restaurant chains in the United States with dressings, sauces, breads and frozen pastas.
